definitions:
L1X -- SELECT lane, step 11: how far does ONE static A^T x reach on MetaQA when it is fed more FLAT hits (ACT) and ranks a larger pool?  (development only; nothing is chosen here)
(User ruling 2026-10-01: L1 = parameter-free routing and SELECTION only -- no traversal, no fitted or learned rule.   User 2026-10-02: "try expanding metaqa oracle and improving the all coverage".)

The shipped IR_L1 feeds the one-hop localisation with the top ACT = 200 FLAT hits and ranks the pool O[:5000].  The reach study (probe_reach) showed the one-hop support of the top-ACT hits covers
ALL golds on 54% (ACT 200), 64% (500), 70% (1000) and 77% (3000) of the MetaQA rows, so the single-product oracle can be expanded.  Here the WHOLE routed pipeline is re-run with (ACT, POOL):
  hits         top-ACT of FLAT, weight 1/(rank+1) * g        (as shipped)
  O            RRF(FLAT, LOC), K0 = 60;  pool = O[:POOL]
  router       ES (shipped) or ES_c (typed order, the L1_TYPED_SELECT_CANDIDATE order) over V_q = hits U LOC;  count B_P(q,K): the shipped knee/alpha rule applied to the SAME hit set ('own'), or the count of the
               ACT = 200 run ('ref', i.e. the shipped count with only the order/ranking fed by more hits)
  served       SHIPPED (O) or TYP = RRF(Sro, Sri, Tin) over the pool (equal weight, K0 = 60);  a gold outside the pool is placed at its exact O position (as in _l1x_rrt_route.py)
Identities for ACT = 200, POOL = 5000: (ES, SHIPPED, own) == the stored kscale verdict on every (row, B_N) and B_P == the stored count.  Half A = even rows, half B = odd rows; everything is also split by hop.

  python -u scratchpad/_l1x_actserve.py RUN metaqa <tag> [--rows=K]     -> results/L1_X/actserve_metaqa__<tag>.{json,npz}  (write-once)
  python -u scratchpad/_l1x_actserve.py SHOW <tag> [K]                  (prints half B, per configuration, and the per-hop split at B_N = 1000)
